title: What Platform Cooperative Federations Is
definition: Platform Cooperative Federations: federations of worker-owned platforms.
description:
Platform Cooperative Federations: federations of worker-owned platforms. This is Post-Scarcity Economy at its most ambitious — coop platforms research, federation logistics engineering and inter-coop trade operations converging on a single goal: making federation hulls real.

Why it matters: Post-Scarcity Economy will decide shared services outcomes this century. Platform Cooperative Federations is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working federation hulls, the larger coop platforms vision stalls, and with it, the federation logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Platform Cooperative Federations in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Platform Cooperative Federations
title: Real Research Today: Platform Cooperative Federations
definition: Today's documented research behind Platform Cooperative Federations.
description:
The road to Platform Cooperative Federations is already being paved. Elinor Ostrom's Nobel-winning work on governing the commons underpins commons economics. Platform cooperativism (Trebor Scholz) builds worker-owned digital platforms.

The Doughnut Economics model (Kate Raworth, Amsterdam) reframes growth within planetary bounds. Together these programs form the coop platforms foundation that Platform Cooperative Federations will build on — the federation logistics results, the inter-coop trade methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as federation logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First city-scale federation hulls pilots launch: coop platforms
title: 2030 — First city-scale federation hulls pilots launch: coop platforms
definition: 2030 milestone on the Platform Cooperative Federations roadmap.
description:
First city-scale federation hulls pilots launch: coop platforms issuance and federation logistics exchange running live.

What must be true first: the coop platforms results have to replicate outside the lab, federation logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and inter-coop trade operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed coop platforms demonstrations, federation logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting inter-coop trade uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Platform Cooperative Federations
definition: Estimates Platform Cooperative Federations readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Platform Cooperative Federations components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a federation hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Platform Cooperative Federations operating for a day.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where coop platforms monitoring, federation logistics redundancy, or inter-coop trade maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Platform Cooperative Federations Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Platform Cooperative Federations: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Platform Cooperative Federations — federations of worker-owned platforms.

Phase 1 — Prove (coop platforms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (federation logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (inter-coop trade): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (shared services): federation hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and workers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
